plugins.name: ai-power-apps
plugins.description: AI Power Ups (apu). Upgrade the AI you already use. One connection gives it live data across travel, markets, research, reading, code, food, fitness and social — with real follow-ups and real links — plus a performance stage, Stock to Stage 3+, that puts more behind every answer, and Projects, a private file space every AI you connect can save to and pick up from. You choose what's on.
